name: jellyfin-mcp
description: Connects your agent to the Jellyfin MCP Server plugin and teaches it to search, recommend, play and manage your Jellyfin library with the jellyfin_* tools

jellyfin_url.title: Jellyfin URL
jellyfin_url.description: Base URL of your Jellyfin server with the MCP Server plugin, without /mcp (for example https://jellyfin.example.com)

jellyfin_token.title: Jellyfin MCP token
jellyfin_token.description: Token created in Jellyfin Dashboard > Plugins > MCP Server
